channel.title: Alabama News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama News Network (alabamanews.net)

item.title: Sunshine Monday, clouds increase Tuesday with rain returning late
item.description: Monday night begins mainly clear, but clouds increase by early Tuesday morning. Low temperatures range from the upper 20s to low 30s.

item.title: ACTION 8 UPDATE: Butler County manhunt canceled; suspect still on the loose
item.description: A manhunt in Butler County has been canceled because it's believed that the suspect is no longer in the area.

item.title: Tuskegee University men’s basketball coach briefly handcuffed after game at Morehouse
item.description: Tuskegee men's basketball coach Benjy Taylor was briefly handcuffed after intervening in an incident involving his team and members of Morehouse's basketball and football teams over the weekend.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court to consider whether to hear Alabama case on panhandling
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court could take up a case about whether panhandling can be banned. It's a debate with a Montgomery connection.

item.title: First business opens at new Merry Corners shopping center in Pike Road
item.description: The first of several businesses has now opened in the new Merry Corners shopping center in Pike Road.

item.title: Local Artists Asked to Share Montgomery’s Story for Black History Month
item.description: Selected pieces will be exhibited February 13–28, 2026, at the Juliette Hampton Morgan Memorial Library.

item.title: Mardi Gras Festivities Roll Into Millbrook This Weekend
item.description: The Millbrook Revelers will host the largest Mardi Gras celebration north of Mobile with more than 60 vendors on site.

item.title: Body of Opelika man found after fire inside a shed
item.description: The body of an Opelika man has been discovered after firefighters put out a fire inside a shed.

item.title: Update: Disappearance of “Today” show host’s mother now considered a crime
item.description: "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's mother is missing in Arizona, and authorities suspect a crime.

item.title: A Chance To Thaw Out!
item.description: We're warming into the lower to mid 60s Tuesday!
